The '''Sartoy system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="RAS2" /> it was the site of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] manufacturing base known as the [[Sartoy weapons plant]].<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sartoy [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-3.<ref name="TEA" />
